src: To investigate if T1 and T2 mapping is able to differentiate between diseased and healthy myocardium in patients with systemic sarcoidosis, and to compare the standard mapping measurement (measurement within the whole myocardium of the midventricular short axis slice, SAX) to a more standardized method measuring relaxation times within the midventricular septum (ConSept).
tgt: Es sollte untersucht werden, ob das T1- und T2-Mapping in der Lage ist, bei Patienten mit systemischer Sarkoidose zwischen erkranktem und gesundem Myokard zu unterscheiden, und die Standard-Mapping-Messung (Messung innerhalb des gesamten Myokards der mittelventrikulären Kurzachsenscheibe, SAX) mit einer standardisierteren Methode zur Messung der Relaxationszeiten innerhalb des mittelventrikulären Septums (ConSept) verglichen werden.
bt_tgt: To investigate whether T1 and T2 mapping is able to distinguish between diseased and healthy myocardium in patients with systemic sarcoidosis and to compare the standard mapping measurement (measurement within the entire myocardium of the midventricular short axis slice, SAX) with a more standardized method for measuring relaxation times within the midventricular septum (ConSept).

What is being investigated?
The investigation is aimed at determining whether T1 and T2 mapping can distinguish between diseased and healthy myocardium in patients with systemic sarcoidosis. Additionally, it compares two methods for measuring these parameters: 
- The standard method involving measurements within the whole myocardium of the midventricular short-axis slice (SAX)
- A more standardized method that measures relaxation times within the midventricular septum (ConSept).

bt_tgt: To investigate whether T1 and T2 mapping is able to distinguish between diseased and healthy myocardium in patients with systemic sarcoidosis and to compare the standard mapping measurement (measurement within the entire myocardium of the midventricular short axis section, SAX) with a more standardized method of measuring relaxation times within the medial ventricular septum (ConSept).

The investigation is aimed at determining whether T1 and T2 mapping can distinguish between diseased and healthy myocardium in patients with systemic sarcoidosis. Additionally, it compares two methods for measuring these parameters: 
- The standard method involving measurements within the whole myocardium of the midventricular short-axis slice (SAX)
- A more standardized method that measures relaxation times within the midventricular septum (ConSept).

src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.

src: Results The retention time of sevoflurane and enflurane was similar to that of ethanol and tert butanol respectively when using the J&W DB-ALC1/DB-ALC2 gas chromatographic column, and interfered with the detection of ethanol content in blood; only J&W DB-ALC1 gas chromatographic column can separate the sevoflurane and ethanol components, so as to eliminate their influence on the detection of ethanol content in blood.
tgt: 结果使用强生W DB-ALC1/DB-ALC2气相色谱柱时，七氟醚和安氟醚的保留时间分别与乙醇和叔丁醇的保留时间相似，干扰了血液中乙醇含量的检测；只有强生DB-ALC1气相色谱柱可以分离七氟醚和乙醇成分，从而消除了它们对血液中乙醇含量检测的影响。

src: Considering the situation of globally pandemic of COVID-19, to decrease the risk of influenza virus infection and minimize the impact on COVID-19 prevention and control, we recommend the following priority for seasonal influenza vaccination: healthcare workers, including clinical doctors and nurses, public health professionals, quarantine professionals; vulnerable groups living in nursing homes or welfare homes and staffs who take care those vulnerable groups; people work or stay in high population density places, such as teachers and students in kindergartens, primary and secondary school, prisoners and staffs of prisons; other high risk group of influenza, including adults ≥60 years of age, children aged 6-59 months, persons with specific chronic diseases, the family members and caregivers of infants <6 months of age, and pregnant women or women who plan to become pregnant during the influenza season.
tgt: 考虑到新型冠状病毒肺炎（COVID-19）全球大流行的形势，为降低流感病毒感染风险，最大限度地减少对COVID-19防控的影响，建议优先接种季节性流感疫苗：医护人员，包括临床医生和护士、公共卫生专业人员、检疫专业人员；居住在疗养院或福利院的弱势群体和照顾这些弱势群体的工作人员；在人口密度大的场所工作或停留的人员，如幼儿园的教师和学生、中小学、监狱的囚犯和工作人员；其他流感高危人群，包括60岁以上的成年人、6-59个月的儿童、患有特定慢性疾病的人、家属和 < 6个月的婴儿的照顾者，以及在流感流行季节计划期间成为孕妇或孕妇的孕妇。

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).

src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL. Linear regression and mediation analyses were used to evaluate the relationships between child functioning, participation, and QoL. Children with greater dependency for managing personal needs and limited eye contact when speaking experienced poorer QoL. Less impaired functioning was associated with more frequent participation, which, in turn, was associated with a 3-point gain in QoL for each additional point in frequency of participation (coefficient=2.67, 95% confidence interval 1.56-3.78).
tgt: Los cuidadores de 435 niños (211 mujeres, 224 hombres; edad media 12 años; SD 3 años 11 meses; rango de edad 5-18 años) con discapacidad intelectual y trastorno del espectro autista, parálisis cerebral, síndrome de Down o síndrome de Rett informaron sobre el funcionamiento de sus hijos (dependencia para gestionar necesidades personales, movilidad, comunicación, contacto visual al hablar), frecuencia de participación y CdV. Se utilizaron análisis de mediación y regresión lineal para evaluar las relaciones entre el funcionamiento, la participación y la CdV del niño. src: The caregivers of 435 children (211 females, 224 males; mean age 12y; SD 3y 11mo; age range 5-18y) with intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, or Rett syndrome reported on their child's functioning (dependence for managing personal needs, mobility, communication, eye contact when speaking), frequency of participation, and QoL.
